validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.passwordHint: Use 8+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.

rules.length: Must be at least 8 characters long
rules.uppercase: Must include at least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
rules.lowercase: Must include at least one lowercase letter (a-z)
rules.number: Must include at least one number (0-9)
rules.special: Must include at least one special character (e.g. !@#$%^&*)
rules.common: Must not be a common password
rules.tooCommon: Password is too common. Choose a stronger password
